source: Hugging Face model cards and API (licence, parameter counts), fetched 2026-10-11; revisions are the pins of the runs; v1 figures are from docs/DECISIONS.md and the dated v1 reports

engines.name: Eos 0.8B (Decision 2.0)
engines.note: CPU figure is the 8-bit ONNX export, the product's CPU path; the other models ran on the CPU in float32 with PyTorch (or their own server).

engines.name: Eos 0.8B, 8-bit ONNX (the portable artifact)
engines.note: Eos run from its 8-bit ONNX export (what a browser or any ONNX runtime loads) on ONNX Runtime with CUDA; the CPU figure is Eos's.

engines.name: Kai 0.6B (Decision 2.0)
engines.note: Scores never reach 0.99 (max 0.931, no calibration shipped), so 0 / 0 at the bar says nothing about its ranking; use the fitted-bar columns.

engines.name: Vela 2.0 0.8B
engines.note: Built on Qwen3.5-0.8B; tokenizer carries the Gemma Terms of Use; asked its own trained hallucination question, not the Decision 2.0 wording.

engines.name: Vela 2.0 0.3B
engines.note: Tokenizer carries the Gemma Terms of Use; asked its own trained hallucination question, not the Decision 2.0 wording.

engines.name: d3-lite 0.85B (Decision 3.0)
engines.note: The runtime loads the backbone in bfloat16 on every device, slow on this CPU (no bf16 matrix instructions): 5.70 s per chunk as shipped, 1.77 with the backbone cast to float32 after loading (scores agree within 0.007 on 14 pairs); the table shows float32. Newer hub revisions have byte-identical weights and score the same.

engines.name: d3-edge 0.6B (Decision 3.0)
engines.note: The runtime loads the backbone in bfloat16 on every device, slow on this CPU (no bf16 matrix instructions): 2.47 s per chunk as shipped, 0.80 with the backbone cast to float32 after loading (scores agree within 0.007 on 14 pairs); the table shows float32. Newer hub revisions have byte-identical weights and score the same.

engines.name: d1-omni 0.6B (LiquidAI)
engines.licence: LFM Open License 1.0 (free for commercial use only under USD 10M revenue)

engines.name: Intern-Decision 0.8B (InternLM)
engines.note: Built on Qwen3.5-0.8B; its own temperature calibration (T = 2.75) compresses scores toward 0.5.

engines.name: Kev 0.8B
engines.note: LoRA adapter and pointer head on Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, run through the author's own server (kev-1.0, reviewed); the server's default CUDA graphs and prefix cache take GPU memory to 7.6 GB.

engines.name: Kev 0.8B (native wording)
engines.note: Same model and server as Kev, asked the claim alone as the question (what the product's System One engine sends). Near chance, probably because a yes/no decision model is given a bare statement.

notRun.name: Mercury Decide (OpenRouter, hosted)
notRun.reason: hosted and no OpenRouter key here; one run is about 36,600 judgments, about 30 hours at the free tier's 20 requests a minute
notRun.v1: AUC 0.998; 108 of 109 decided correct, 0 false supports at 0.99
